expected_behavior: The script covers only steps a person must do — a vendor dashboard, a CI secret, an approval — and never steps the agent could automate.
Secrets are typed with hidden entry, and each value lands where the scope said it goes — .env, a CI secret, or both.
Each stage ends at a confirmation gate, and the script closes with a summary of what was set.
The shared library above the STAGES marker is left untouched; only the stages are authored.
The script is deleted after one run unless the user asks to keep it.
